designSystem.title: Ember Cash design system
designSystem.intro: Tokens (Light / Dark), type, components and icons. Showing the {theme} theme. All figures are sample data.
designSystem.colorTokens: Color tokens (light swatch front, dark behind)
designSystem.icons: Icons (Uicons by Flaticon: regular rounded, solid rounded)
designSystem.iconsAttribution: Icons designed by Flaticon (Uicons) from flaticon.com. Free licence requires visible attribution.
designSystem.statesIntro: Focus ring: 2 px #BD490A (dark #FF9552), offset 2 px. Pressed: scale 0.97. Sample data only.
designSystem.emptyDescription: Add your first transaction or import a bank file to see your month take shape.
designSystem.loadingNote: Skeleton matches final row geometry; shimmer is static under reduced motion.
designSystem.toastNote: Toast replaces a confirmation dialog; stays 6 s, Undo restores the item.
designSystem.freshNote: Fetched today. Converted amounts show with the chip's date.
designSystem.staleNote: Older than 24 h: amber chip with the old date. Converted amounts stay, tooltip says 'rate from {date}'. Click refreshes.
designSystem.updatingNote: Chip keeps its width. Numbers do not move; converted lines dim to 60% until done.
designSystem.errorNote: Rate not available: originals stay primary, each converted line reads 'rate unavailable' instead of a stale number.
designSystem.pointerNote: Press and hold 2 s, fill sweeps left to right. Release cancels.
designSystem.keyboardNote: Same fill and focus ring. Releasing the key or Esc cancels. Screen reader: '{hint}'.
designSystem.twoStepNote: Second press within 4 s, then a toast with Undo (6 s) before the delete is final.
designSystem.contrastNote: Label contrast: ink on the red fill is 10.45 (light) / 9.69 (dark); red text on the fill was 3.29 / 3.64 and was replaced.
designSystem.moneyNote: The selected currency comes first; the original goes below only if it differs. ≈ appears only in totals. Hover an amount to see the rate.
